description: Deterministic manifest for the latest ossification dataset distribution.

cohortRules.datasetAdmission: losses meet the 1000 USD floor through loss.usd or an evidenced loss.minimumUsd lower bound
cohortRules.curveUsdComparability: the curve is narrower than dataset admission: it requires a concrete loss.usd.amount, not only a lower bound
curveInclusion: ageReset.kind describes deployment, executable-code change, or a causal configuration change
cohortRules.deduplication: two passes, each keeping the earliest exploit under the deterministic selection order: first group by (incidentId, failureModeId) so sibling instances of one template collapse to one observation, then by (codeArtifact.codeHash, failureModeId) so byte-identical artifacts collapse across incidents
cohortRules.deduplicationSelectionOrder: for observations on the same chain with complete exploit anchors: blockNumber, transactionIndex, timestamp, incidentId, target id; otherwise: timestamp, chainId, incidentId, target id
cohortRules.incidentReference: observation.incidentId resolves the incident-level summary and loss in incidents.json, which lists reviewed incidents only; loss is intentionally not copied onto each target observation, and an incident that contributes several observations owns one loss, so a loss-weighted curve must aggregate per incidentId rather than sum per observation
